about: Warm speaker footage, compact white bold words, warm yellow handwriting, hard-cut black statement slides.

motion.layered_words: 2-4 short spoken runs reveal in order and stay together until the thought ends; paired layout puts elegant yellow above bold white

composition.speaker_text: elegant yellow and bold white paired close at chest; rough yellow for product words and numbers; small serif captions between beats
composition.upper_handwriting: white rough note and optional pointing cue only where space above head permits
composition.black_slide: centered safe rectangle with one yellow spoken line
